title: J2: JMAP chat id derived from the room URI
description: JMAP chat ids are ULIDs; MIMI rooms are URIs; no derivation is defined. Recommended: derive the ULID deterministically from SHA-256(room URI) so every device's agent agrees (or add a 'Chat identifiers' section to draft-atwood-jmap-chat-mimi-00). PENDING Mark (from the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI comparison 2026-10-18); decide when mimid-1wgh.13 is planned.
